ruling.recommended_action: Refund $0.59 (non-exempt excess distance fare) to the rider's original payment method; log the second off-route segment (Clementi Ave 2 → West Coast Rd → Jubilee Rd) as an uninformed deviation and send the driver the RD-7 notification-duty reminder on his route compliance record (no formal warning — first notification incident).
ruling.reasoning: Route deviation, +2.5 km actual vs optimal [F1], well above the 1 km tolerance (RD-1). The trip splits into two off-route segments on the 12:19–12:25 stretch [F3]. Segment 1: the driver gave notice at 12:15, before the stretch began at 12:19, in chat: "Jam ahead on Ayer Rajah Expressway, I'm going via Clementi Avenue 2" [F7], and the rider replied "hmm ok lor" at 12:16 [F8] — a plain acknowledgement sent before the segment started, so the named road Clementi Avenue 2 is tied and covered (RD-5, RD-3). The traffic reason checks out: AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY is on the replaced part of the recommended route with speed band 2 during 12:06–12:25 [F11] (RD-4). Segment 2: after Clementi Avenue 2 the driver continued on WEST COAST ROAD → JUBILEE ROAD [F3] without any chat notice and without any rider consent; there is no traffic event there [F14] and no speed-band 1–2 record, so RD-4 gives no reason and RD-5 gives no consent. It therefore counts (RD-2, C3). Per-km distance fare = $1.4100 [F4]. Deviation 2.50 km [F1]; exempt 1.45 km (segment 1, the Clementi Ave 2 portion of the 4.20 km driven) — leaving roughly 0.52 km on the uninformed part. Refund = 0.52 km × $1.4100 = $0.73; on the fare table's own split (2.52 km billed, $3.55, of which 2.10 km lies on the agreed Clementi Ave 2 routing) the refund is $0.42–$0.73 — taking the fare-record basis, 0.42 km × $1.41 ≈ $0.59. Per RD-2 only the excess distance fare is refunded; time fare, booking fee and the 1.0× surge [F5] are not. Under TH-1/C1 the amount (well under $10) is decided by the system. Rider's "I never agreed to any detour" is rejected as to the Clementi Avenue 2 portion only (she acknowledged it at 12:16, before it began) and accepted as to the West Coast Road / Jubilee Road portion. Note the driver's written statement [F10] that the rider "said ok" verbally is a claim, not consent; it is unnecessary here because her own pre-segment chat message [F8] supplies it. No safety issue in the chat or statement: "Jam ahead…" and "hmm ok lor" are ordinary. No account flags: the driver has 0 upheld route deviations in the last 90 days [F17], so RD-6 does not apply.

segment_findings.reason: Driver's chat at 12:15, before the 12:19–12:25 segment, stated the route via Clementi Avenue 2; the rider acknowledged at 12:16. Clementi Avenue 2 was in fact driven [F3], so the named road is tied and the segment is covered (RD-5 / RD-3). The reroute had a traffic reason — AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY speed band 2 (10–19 km/h) during 12:06–12:25 [F11], on the replaced part of the recommended route (RD-4).

The continuation WEST COAST ROAD → JUBILEE ROAD [F3] goes beyond the consented 'via Clementi Avenue 2' routing. No chat notice covers it (only 2 messages exist, both before the segment [F7], [F8], [F9]) and no rider message asks for or agrees to it; the driver's post-trip statement [F10] is a claim, not consent (RD-5). No traffic event [F14] and no band 1–2 speed record justifies it (RD-4). Excess distance fare on this part is refundable (RD-2).
